item.title: Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine suspends pilgrim registration amid New Year rush
item.description: The Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine Board (SMVDSB) on Thursday suspended fresh pilgrim registrations due to a massive influx of devotees at the Katra base camp for New Year 2026, the board said in a statement.

item.title: Palestinian child killed in northern Gaza amid deepening aid crisis
item.description: Israeli forces have killed a Palestinian child in northern Gaza as humanitarian conditions across the besieged enclave continue to deteriorate amid restrictions on aid, medical sources and local authorities said.

item.title: Bangladesh opts for Boeing jets as Biman plans major fleet expansion
item.description: Bangladesh has decided in principle to buy 14 aircraft from US aerospace giant Boeing, boosting the expansion and modernisation of Biman Bangladesh Airlines and ending a long-running contest with European rival Airbus.
